title: Wands in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
description: Six to Ten of Wands in tarot: upright and reversed meanings, from recognition and resilience to overload, plus how to read them in a tarot spread.

scenes.headline: Wands in tarot: Six to Ten meanings
scenes.caption: The Six to Ten of Wands follow the fire suit from recognition to overload. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.
scenes.vo: The Six to Ten of Wands follow the fire suit from recognition to overload. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

scenes.headline: Six of Wands
scenes.caption: Recognition, victory, confidence. A rider wearing a laurel wreath moves through a crowd, with a wand crowned by another wreath.
scenes.vo: Six of Wands. Recognition, victory, confidence. A rider wearing a laurel wreath moves through a crowd, with a wand crowned by another wreath.

scenes.headline: Seven of Wands
scenes.caption: Defending your position, perseverance, standing firm. A figure on higher ground holds a wand against six others rising from below.
scenes.vo: Seven of Wands. Defending your position, perseverance, standing firm. A figure on higher ground holds a wand against six others rising from below.

scenes.headline: Eight of Wands
scenes.caption: Speed, movement, news arriving. Eight wands fly diagonally through open sky with no figure in sight.
scenes.vo: Eight of Wands. Speed, movement, news arriving. Eight wands fly diagonally through open sky with no figure in sight.
